title: Slow Push Into Forest Cabin
tests: Tests a sustained text-specified camera push with depth and foreground parallax rather than a static image or simple zoom.

faults.what: The clip is 6.6 seconds long rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: A convincing dawn-lit wooden cabin is approached with clear foreground-tree parallax, though the clip runs slightly longer than requested.

must_haves.item: A realistic wooden cabin sits among pine trees in dawn lighting.
must_haves.why: The cabin has realistic timber textures and is surrounded by pines under soft, warm early-morning light.

must_haves.item: The camera advances smoothly toward the cabin's front door throughout the six-second shot.
must_haves.why: Successive frames show a steady approach, with the cabin and front door progressively enlarging while the door remains near the center.

must_haves.item: Foreground trees shift relative to the cabin, visibly conveying forward movement through space.
must_haves.why: Nearby trunks move outward substantially relative to the cabin, producing clear depth and forward-motion parallax.

must_haves.item: The cabin and trees retain consistent shapes without scene changes or cuts.
must_haves.why: The roof, door, porch, furniture, and tree trunks remain consistent across the supplied frames, with no visible scene change.

must_haves.item: The output is widescreen and silent.
must_haves.why: The frames are visibly widescreen, but silence cannot be verified from still images.
